topic: Day 121 — reel — Resilience includes knowing when to ask for support, not just going solo
text:
Asking for help
is [resilience], not
the failure of it.
caption:
Self-reliance gets treated as the whole trait. Having people to call is one of the strongest predictors of recovering fast.
